Though it is true to say that F-Droid contains open source software, F-Droid goes one better than that: it contains only Free software. That is to say, Free as in Freedom, not free as in beer.

For software to be 'open source' means only that the source code can be read by a human. It makes not assurances beyond that.

If software is Free, then it will, in addition to ability to read the source code, grant you the following:

  • Freedom 0 Use: Freedom to use the software in any way you like, for business, reverse engineering, etc
  • Freedom 1 Study: Freedom to read and audit the code, for security and education, for example
  • Freedom 2: Share: Freedom to distribute identical copies so your friends can benefit or help
  • Freedom 3: Improve: Freedom to modify the code, so that you can fix bugs, personalize it, etc

The GPL is a Free software licence.

Honestly, another good one that I didn't think of at the time...writing. Here's the trick. You need pen and fucking paper. If you have a yard, even better. Grab a shovel, some lighter fluid and matches. I know, sounds weird but hang with me a bit.

Write down, like physically write down, whatever it is that's fucking with you. Whatever has you in that state write it down. Write down what's going through your mind. Not what you're feeling, what you're thinking. You're literally forcing your logic center to take over through the physical act of writing. Write that shit over and over and over again if you have to. Have a small, deep hole dug in your back yard. Keep writing. Once you have it all written down, take the paper outside with the matches. Ball the pages up, drop them into the hole, douse the paper in lighter fluid and then drop a lit match into the hole. Watch it burn into oblivion and let it know that you're the one who has enough fire to keep it burning. Once the flame is low, bury it and pack it in.

This one worked for me a bit when the walks weren't enough. I was literally putting all my shit down on that paper, burning it and burying it. It was in that hole and it wasn't coming out.
